title: Stat Strip
description: An editorial row of headline figures, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a short line over a grid of large serif values, each above its muted label on a hairline rule, with an optional action and its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the action beside the heading at @sm, a larger heading and values at @md, and all four figures on one row with more room above and below at @lg.
